Figure 4:Proposed PACT architecture.Source embeddings define fixed nearest-centroid charts. Each arriving condition provides a small labeled calibration set to learn chart-specific residual transports, which are then frozen and appended to the transport bank. Chart-specific gates are refit using retained source and calibration embeddings. At inference, the selected chart’s gate combines the identity branch and available transports, and the frozen head classifies the corrected embedding. The encoder and head remain unchanged throughout adaptation.
Figure 6:PACT across eight backbones.Each cell is the mean AMF1. The columns cover classification-pretrained, forecasting-pretrained, and task-specific encoders.
